messages:
claire: PartnerEdge flagged that a batch of AWS Marketplace usage for Mar 10-12 arrived with BuyerReference set to their master account instead of downstream buyer tags.

tom-eng: sample?

claire: snippet from their CSV attached to ticket:
```
Tx,Start,End,BuyerReference,Product,Qty,Cost
p-9001,2026-03-10,2026-03-10,partneredge-master-555,redwood-llm,3600,72.00
```

marta-fin: If unmapped this will appear as unattributed revenue on customer invoices. We need a reconciliation plan and provisional credits.

partner-ops: PartnerEdge says a provisioning script change on 2026-03-09 flipped export keys. They uploaded a downstream mapping file for Mar10-12 and offered to re-run exports.

tom-eng: Quick mitigation: add fallback in marketplace-ingest to consult partner-specific mapping artifacts for the date window when BuyerReference matches partner pattern. ETA ~48h for patch + canary.

marta-fin: Finance requests CSV format for credits: downstream_customer_id, affected_cost, invoice_period, partner_ref, tx_count. We'll mark as 'provisional'.

partner-ops: PartnerEdge approved provisional PO for credits and will push corrected exports within 72h.

billing-audit-bot: audit: ticket-7037 created, mapping_file uploaded to /evidence/ticket-7037 at 2026-03-12T16:22:05Z

claire: Opening BILL-7037; keeping thread open until re-export processed and credits issued.
